acquisition_method: The mass spectrometer was operated in standard data dependent acquisition mode controlled by Xcalibur 2.1.
alkylation_reagent: cysteine alkylation was performed in situ with iodoacetamide and proteins were digested with Trypsin Gold (Promega)
cleavage_agent: cysteine alkylation was performed in situ with iodoacetamide and proteins were digested with Trypsin Gold (Promega) for 4 h at 37 degreesC at an enzyme substrate ratio of 1:20
enrichment_method: Peptides were re-suspended in IMAC loading buffer (50% acetonitrile, 0.1% TFA) and incubated with pre-equilibrated Phos-Select beads (Sigma) for 1 h at room temperature.
fragmentation_method: the top 10 most abundant multiply-charged (2 + and higher) ions in a given chromatographic window subjected to either CID or ETD fragmentation in the linear ion trap with supplemental activation enabled.
instrument: coupled to an LTQ Orbitrap Velos hybrid mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific) equipped with a nanospray ion source.
ionization_type: coupled to an LTQ Orbitrap Velos hybrid mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific) equipped with a nanospray ion source.
labeling: inferred: No labeling strategy is mentioned in the text; the study describes direct LC-MS/MS analyses with no reference to TMT, iTRAQ, SILAC, dimethyl, or ICAT.
